Hi Team,

Great to get this show rolling with you. Here is the link to our show google drive. 
[FOLDER_LINK]
Please always upload all show relevant files to this folder so nothing get's lost in the process.

For the next steps I’d like to gather the following information from you:

Venue Info
•⁠  ⁠Capacity GA & VIP
•⁠  ⁠Photos of the venue
•⁠  ⁠Stage view incl. background (what the guests will see)
•⁠  ⁠FOH view incl. background (what the artist will see)
•⁠  ⁠Drone shots or general photos/videos to get a proper feeling for the site and surroundings
•⁠  ⁠Photos, links, or videos from previous events
•⁠  ⁠Google Maps link
•⁠  ⁠Full venue address

Layout
•⁠  ⁠Initial 2D layout to start with
•⁠  ⁠3D layout (DWG or VWX) if you have it already (we’ll need it later in the process) 

Restrictions / Limitations
•⁠  ⁠Any sound or light restrictions (e.g. dB limits, D&B licensing, curfews, etc.)

Timing
•⁠  ⁠Opening hours, sunset/sunrise times, and sun orientation – this helps us plan stage and audience setup

Equipment Vendor
•⁠  ⁠List of available audio, lighting, and rigging equipment

Contacts
•⁠  ⁠Please share a full contact list (production, tech, management, etc.)

If you have any questions, please let me know.

Looking forward to working with you ! 

All the best,


Hannes

Hi there,

Great to meet everyone. My name is Jelle (pronounced “yell-uh”) and I’ll be &ME’s production manager and show designer for this event. 

In order to get this production started, could you please upload the following files to our Google Drive folder linked below? 

Venue info
- 3D venue files with current stage design (possible formats: vwx, mvr, c2p, dwg, skp)
- Inventory catalog of your light show supplier, including units in stock (pdf, excel)
- ArrayCalc / soundvision file
- VIP-table layout (if not present in venue 3D files)
- Venue photos from FOH position, stage position and drone/satellite

In this email thread, could you please let me know:
1) Any restrictions I should keep in mind, such as maximum height, natural obstacles and local regulations that might be relevant
2) Which rigging towers are available (Layher incl max height and minimum width, StageCo towers, Square truss towers incl max height, etc)
3) Your preferred 3D file format for me to send to you: vwx, mvr or c2p

Please upload your files here: [FOLDER_LINK]
It would be of great help if the files could be uploaded before [DEADLINE]

Design
After receiving the files, I will design the light show and might do some adaptations on the stage design. 
I will provide you with:

- Fixture list
- Light & stage design as pdf and 3D file
- Whether/which setpiece we will be bringing
- MA3 showfile including fixture IDs, but excluding DMX patch (please ask your local team to add the dmx patch to the MA3 file)
- Soundvision file (if adaptations are necessary)

Riders: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1l6Jx2H3_HylI-JgnYAz4BgmrbGEIeOUX?usp=drive_link
- Technical Rider
- Production Checklist
- Light Operator Guide

Looking forward to working together! Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.
